A bold wrapper holding only a line break still separates the words on either side

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<b>Alpha</b><b><br></b><b>Beta</b>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
